answer: The oasis is that the door answers to Inducted spinner hall oath alone, and an oath spinners swear before fleece witnesses is the lock it turns. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. Nobody is waved through free: a fare of £22 for the journey to the registry, paid per name is the price, and the nectar never covers it twice. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The tally keeps wander.
